Preferred Vendor Badge

For the local businesses on our Preferred Vendors list: an optional badge you can add to your website so your customers can see you’re a trusted Your Realty Link partner.

Pick a badge

Copy the code and paste it into your website wherever you list partners, credentials or affiliations. The badge links to our Preferred Vendors page, where your business is listed.

Light badge

Dark badge

Prefer a text link?

Where to paste it

  1. WordPress: add a Custom HTML block (or widget) to your footer, About or Partners page and paste the code.
  2. Wix: use Embed Code → Embed HTML and paste the code.
  3. Squarespace: add a Code block and paste the code.
  4. Anything else: send the code to whoever manages your site, or email us and we’ll help.

Adding the badge is optional. Your listing on our Preferred Vendors page doesn’t depend on it, and no one pays or receives anything for a listing or a link. To update your listing or ask a question, email indy@yourrealtylink.com.
